# Bounded owner default accessor

A genuine Kotlin all-compatibility interface has one nominally bounded owner
formal. Its default accepts that formal in three slots and returns the same
formal. Frozen bytecode callers, reflection and method handles compare virtual
calls with static compatibility calls; the latter must bypass an override while
the original body still calls its duration and velocity methods virtually.

The observer checks all three input identities, nulls, result identity, signed
and high-bit long values, ordered effects and the original failure object.
All original definitions, complete generic Signatures, Exceptions and runtime
metadata are compared after only the existing disclosed private body helper and
synthetic flag projection. D8 CLASS annotation loss is recorded separately.
Four independent wrong programs must be detected. The nominal bound is tested
both as an owned DEX definition and as an unchanged dependency declaration.

`--object-bound` authors the same Kotlin contract with an `Any` owner bound
before compilation. Its frozen observers use Object, Integer, String and null
references and add exact Error failures alongside RuntimeException. The SDK
profile borrows the unchanged overriding implementation, verifying that virtual
calls still select that override while compatibility calls execute the original
default body and retain its internal virtual calls. Only the existing disclosed
helper/synthetic projection is allowed; all original compiler bytes stay fixed.
